meta.title: Events Certificates: a WordPress Meetup
meta.description: Try Events Certificates with a Base design that says WORDPRESS MEETUP: open the Generator, add the people of your meetup and download their certificates.
meta.author: camaleaun

steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Events Certificates: WordPress Meetup wording (Playground)
 *
 * The plugin's Base design says nothing about meetups. A site that wants "WORDPRESS MEETUP" on the
 * band and "took part in the meetup" gives it through the evcert_base_design filter, as a network can.
 */
add_filter(
	'evcert_base_design',
	static function ( $design ) {
		foreach ( $design['elements'] as &$element ) {
			if ( 'band-text' === ( $element['id'] ?? '' ) ) {
				$element['runs'] = array( array( 'text' => 'WORDPRESS MEETUP' ) );
			}
			if ( 'took-part' === ( $element['id'] ?? '' ) ) {
				$element['runs'] = array( array( 'text' => 'took part in the meetup' ) );
			}
		}

		return $design;
	}
);
